name: [Portal] Public medailonek read API over CRM (BE)
description:
### Summary

This task builds the read-only interface through which the public partner websites and the addon marketplace will obtain partner profiles (medailonky) once CRM becomes the single source of truth. Today each site keeps its own copy of the profile text; after the Partner Portal launches, partners edit their profile in one place and every public surface must read from that record. The task delivers an API that lists approved profiles per language with filters and pagination, returns a single profile by its slug, renders the text fields through the shared restricted-Markdown converter, and never exposes drafts, pending texts, hidden partners or internal fields such as the billing e-mail. It also documents which fields feed which website, answering wiki question Q3, and adds caching headers so static-site builds can call it freely. The websites that consume the API, and the decision whether they stay on WordPress or move to static microsites, are separate tasks. It depends on the partner domain layer and the Markdown converter.

### Why?

Both partner websites (partneri.shoptet.cz for CZ/SK/HU) and the addon marketplace (doplnky.shoptet.cz) show partner medailonky, but today each reads its own copy (WordPress content, `services_lng.expert*`), not CRM. The MVP scope makes CRM the master record and connects the websites to an API over it. No such API exists in the monorepo. Wiki Q3 asks which fields go to which website and what API or mapping is missing; this task answers it with a contract.

### What?

A read-only API serving approved medailonky from CRM: list per language (filter by category and country, pagination, changed-since) and detail by slug. Output has public fields, categories, text fields rendered to HTML by the restricted-Markdown converter, and a plain-text snippet. Pending, rejected or hidden partners and unapproved texts are never returned. A documented field mapping for the partner websites and for the addon author card. Consumers (websites, WordPress or static) are separate tasks.

### Acceptance Criteria

List endpoint per language (cs/sk/hu) with filters category, country, 

changedSince

 and pagination; detail by slug

Only partners in an active status with an approved text in the requested language are returned; draft, pending, rejected and hidden never leak (test)

Text fields returned as HTML from the converter in 

 plus a plain-text snippet; byte-identical to the portal preview (contract test)

Public fields only, via an explicit allow-list; billing e-mail, CIN/TIN and internal fields excluded

Field mapping documented in the package: which fields feed partneri.shoptet.cz and which feed the addon author card on doplnky.shoptet.cz (Q3)

ETag / Last-Modified and a default TTL; the list is cheap enough for a static-site build to call on every build

OpenAPI description committed next to the code; integration tests for list, detail, filters and the no-leak rule; PHPStan level 10

### Open questions

- Wiki Q3: exact field set per website, to confirm with Partnership and marketing.
- Language fallback: when SK has no approved text, hide the partner on the SK site or fall back to CZ?
- Auth: fully public (public data only) or a token for build pipelines? Rate limits?
- Where the endpoint lives: `cms/packages/PartnerPortal` (DevRel) vs. `api/` or `marketplace/` (api-team). Decide with api-team.

### Technical notes

_Generated by Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-09-16_

- No partner-profile endpoint exists: `api/` (Addon REST API) has none; `marketplace/` (doplnky.shoptet.cz, Nette) exposes only `api/addons` and `api/addons/<id>` (`marketplace/app/Router/RouterFactory.php:34`); `marketplace/app/Api/DTO/AddonDTO.php` has `developer` as a bare string.
- Today's addon author card reads `services_lng.expert*` raw in `marketplace/app/Addon/Addon.php:192` and `marketplace/app/Addon/Helper.php:64`; the addon → partner link for the card needs a mapping (services ↔ `st_api.partner` ↔ `st_crm.partner`).
- partneri.shoptet.cz has no code in the monorepo (WordPress, external).
- Ownership (CODEOWNERS): `/api`, `/marketplace` → @shoptet/api-team; `cms/packages/PartnerPortal` → @shoptet/devrel-team.
- Data: `st_crm.partner` (status, globally unique slug), `partner_lng` (status approved), `partner_category_lng.slug` unique per (slug, language).
